public.instruction: Insert the supplied [string key, JSON value] pairs into a cache and return its [key, value] pairs in insertion order. Keys in the input are unique. None or zero capacity means unlimited; positive integer capacities keep the newest capacity entries by evicting the oldest before insertion. Empty input returns []. Repeated-key updates and negative limits are outside scope.
